id: title:Gilbert09:show sync run counts with separators and share

review.posthog_relevance: Customer Analytics warehouse configuration UI display formatting
review.reason: Adds and applies human-readable number and percentage formatting utilities to warehouse account configuration run summaries, replacing raw integer displays with formatted values and percentage shares.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunks; no broader context or test results provided. No evidence of runtime behavior, compatibility, or actual benefit, only implementation and display changes.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are contained within a single file path and share the same change group. No other PRs are supplied, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds import of humanFriendlyNumber and percentage utility functions.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides formatting helpers for displaying numbers and percentages in the Customer Analytics warehouse configuration UI.

observations.behavior: Replaces raw numeric display of warehouse run counts with human-friendly formatting; adds updatedShare helper to compute and display share as percentage or '<1%' for very small shares.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse account configuration to display warehouse run results with formatted numbers and percentage shares rather than raw integers, improving readability of warehouse ingestion results.

observations.behavior: Updates warehouse account configuration run summary to use humanFriendlyNumber for warehouse entity counts and updatedShare for percentage share; preserves existing and skipped counts, adds share parenthetical when available.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse account configuration run summary to use humanFriendlyNumber for warehouse entity counts and updatedShare for percentage share, preserving existing and skipped counts, adds share parenthetical when available.
